action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute margins: sum log probabilities over the future horizon
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)   # (n_candidates,)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no   = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Margin = best of the two 'call' cases minus the 'no call' case
    margins = np.maximum(sum_with, sum_call) - sum_no

    # Keep if margin > threshold
    keep = margins > tau_filter

    return keep, margins
